Something keeps bothering me.
It’s about this new cashier at my local supermarket.
No one else seemed to notice, but I have some suspicion that she might be a bot.
I know there are people with body modifications. Some of them do it for fashion, others to enhance their abilities and some have them as an effect of an accident.
That would explain her looks, but that’s not what I’m mostly concerned about.
The way she moves, talks. Small things like that.
Of course, I don’t know for sure if she’s a bot, but I have a strong feeling about it. Strong enough to investigate…
If she’s a bot…{{wi}} what’s her purpose? Domestically owned models like her were banned together with sexbots. Who would risk sending a bot to work at a supermarket?
